vis.notes.title: Halation layers — {title}
vis.notes.spec: {w}×{h} · {fps} fps · {time} ({frames} frames). Every file starts at 0 and has the same length, frame rate and size.
vis.notes.order: Place them on the timeline in this order, from the bottom track to the top one:
vis.notes.alpha: Transparent layers: {format} with straight (not premultiplied) alpha. DaVinci Resolve and Premiere detect it; CapCut keeps the transparency of ProRes 4444 and WebM files.
vis.notes.baked: Finish: grain and fades are baked into the layers; the vignette is part of the background.
vis.notes.overlay: Finish: 04 Finish is grain over 50 % grey; set its blend mode to Overlay. Fades are in the other layers; the vignette is part of the background.
vis.notes.glow: The cover glow is in 02 Cover and its colour was computed over this background: if you replace the background, export again with the glow off.
vis.notes.env: 06 Bass envelope: the bass level of each frame from 0 to 1 (white = 1; the CSV goes above 1 on strong hits), as a grayscale video and as a CSV with one value per frame.
vis.notes.frozen: Made with Halation. The settings were frozen when the export started.

cv.empty.title: Drop any file
cv.empty.note: Video, audio, pictures, documents or PDFs, one or a whole folder. Halation shows only the formats each file can become.
cv.d.a.mp3: Lossy · VBR about 245 kbps (V0) · plays everywhere
cv.d.a.m4a: AAC 256 kbps · lossy · phones and Apple apps
cv.d.a.flac: Lossless · 16 or 24 bit as the source · about half the size of WAV
cv.d.a.wav: Uncompressed PCM · 16 or 24 bit as the source · the largest
cv.d.a.ogg: Vorbis about 192 kbps (q6) · lossy · open format
cv.d.a.opus: 160 kbps · 48 kHz · the best quality for its size, less supported
cv.d.a.aiff: Uncompressed PCM · 16 or 24 bit as the source · for Mac apps
cv.d.v.mp4: H.264 (CRF 18) and AAC 192 kbps, or copied when they fit · plays everywhere
cv.d.v.mkv: Copies every stream, subtitles included · any codec, fewer players
cv.d.v.webm: VP9 (CRF 31) and Opus 160 kbps, or copied when they fit · for the web
cv.d.v.mov: H.264 (CRF 18) and AAC 192 kbps, or copied when they fit · for editors
cv.d.v.gif: 15 fps · up to 480 px wide · 256 colours, no sound · large files
cv.d.anim.mp4: H.264 (CRF 18) · much smaller than a GIF · plays everywhere
cv.d.anim.webm: VP9 (CRF 31) · keeps transparency · for the web
cv.d.anim.gif: 256 colours · plays in any browser or chat
cv.d.anim.webp: Quality 90 · animated, keeps transparency · smaller than GIF
cv.d.anim.png: Lossless · the first frame as a picture
cv.d.i.jpg: Quality 90 · lossy · no transparency · the smallest for photos
cv.d.i.webp: Quality 90 (lossless for flat colours) · keeps transparency · small
cv.d.pdf.png: One picture per page at 200 dpi · lossless
cv.d.pdf.jpg: One picture per page at 200 dpi · quality 90 · smaller
cv.d.doc.pdf: Fixed layout · looks the same everywhere
cv.d.doc.rtf: Formatted text · opens in almost any editor
cv.d.doc.md: Markdown · plain text with formatting marks
cv.d.doc.html: Web page · opens in any browser
cv.d.doc.epub: E-book · the text flows to the screen
cv.d.doc.csv: Plain values · the first sheet only
